newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: North and Central America port conditions -Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions -Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

EL SALVADOR, Jan 27, Acajutla - 12 Vessels due (containers, steel products, general cargo, machinery, sugar, steel products, fertiliser, vehicles). Delays depend on weather conditions. 3 Vessels discharging at berth (soya, ammonium sulphate, containers, general cargo, passengers.

HONDURAS, Jan 27 - Puerto Cortes - Vessels berthed, 4 discharging/loading containers, 1 loading bananas/discharging containers, 1 discharging fertiliser, 1 tourist vessel. Vessels awaiting berth, 2 to discharge/load containers, 1 to load zinc concentrate. Vessels due, 4 to discharge bananas, 1 passenger vessel, 4 to load/discharge containers. Six vessels berthed of which 1 passenger, 2 discharging/loading containers/generals, 1 loading bananas, 1 loading zinc concentrates, 1 discharging fertiliser. 1 Vessel anchored in ballast, 15 due of which 8 to discharge/load containers/generals, 5 to load bananas, 1 to discharge fertiliser, 1 to discharge liquid chemicals. No berthing delays expecte

MEXICO, Jan 28 - Tampico - Vessels in port, 1 iron sheets, 1 sugar, 1 gasoline, 1 diesel, 3 minerals, working normally. Altamira - Vessels in port, 1 container, 1 general cargo, 1 anchored with cars, working normally. Veracruz - Vessels in port, 1 cars, 3 pipes, 2 container vessels, 1 sugar, 3 general cargo, 1 repairs, working normally. Manzanillo - Vessels in port, 3 general cargo, 1 cement, 1 clinker, 1 fruit, 2 containers, working normally. Coatzacoalcos - Vessels in port, 4 chemicals, 10 oil tankers, 1 under repair, working normally.

PANAMA, Jan 27 - Balboa - Vessels operating, 1 container carrier, 1 tanker. Cristobal - Vessels operating, 1 chemical tanker, 3 general cargo,1 general reefer, 1 lpg, 1 roro, 1 vehicle carrier. Panama Canal - 41 Vessels due, 24 in queue, 13 booked, 39 scheduled. Average of booked and non-booked canal waters time is 14.3 hrs. Those using the booking system are required to give cargo, draft and ETA as soon as possible.

UNITED STATES, Jan 27 - Jersey City, NJ - One vessel in port. Port Newark, NJ - Two vessels in port. Port Elizabeth, NJ - Two vessels in port. Bayway, Cartaret, NJ - One vessel in each port. Baltimore, MD - Vessels operating in port, 8 bulkers, 4 container vessels, 1 ro-ro, 2 auto vessels, 2 tankers, 3 general cargo, 2 cable vessels on standby, 4 vessels in repair yard. 7 Bulkers awaiting berth of which 1 to discharge salt, 4 to discharge sugar, 1 to load containers, 1 other. Honolulu, HI - One container vessel, 1 tanker and 4 tugs and barges alongside, 1 bulk carrier anchored. Barbers Point, HI - Two barges alongside, no vessels at offport moorings. Hampton Roads, VA - Three general car

EAST COAST - Baltimore, MD - No congestion at Dundalk terminal, minor ice conditions in the canal, Baltimore harbour low ceiling, elevators and coal operations working well with no delays. 3 Days delay for Consol coal, liquid bulk facilities operating normally, no berthing congestion. Charleston, SC - No vessels due, no delays at tanker terminals, vessels due at Allied terminal on 29/1. Jacksonville - No congestion. Miami, FL - No congestion at container berths, gantry berths and ro-ro berths. New York, NY - Congestion exists in sugar terminals. Norfolk, VA - 16 Vessels due at coal pier, 2 anchored waiting to load. 11 Vessels due at Dominion terminal, 4 vessels due at pier six coal termi

GULF COAST - Houston, TX - The ship channel has been closed due to fog since 22/1 1730 hours, approx. 42 vessels are waiting outside, congestion expected in city docks during the weekend, congestion also at some oil, chemical docks and private terminals for breakbulk cargoes. Mobile, AL - No congestion. New Orleans, LA - River stage at 7 ft., expected to drop to 6.5 ft by 28/1, and up to 7.3 ft. by 2/2. Drafts for the Mississippi remain unchanged.

WEST COAST - Columbia river - 12 Grain vessels in port of which 7 loading 5 waiting. Coos Bay - Port busy, chip vessels loading at Roseburg dock, log vessels loading at Ocean terminal. Glenbrook nickel terminal discharging 1 vessel. Honolulu, HI - BHP had a minor grounding with one of their two bunker barges last week, vessels are experiencing up to 12 hours delay waiting for fuel. Long Beach, CA - Metropolitan, moderately busy for February, 2-3 days delay at anchor expected. Koch Carbon, 2 vessels due in February. Kaiser, busy for February, 3-4 days awaiting berth for coal,petcoke, bulk cargoes busy in February, 2-3 days bulker loading delays due to rain/snow.
